role_agent_name: Diving safety and subsea operations officer (DIVE)
abstract: Maintains saturation dive systems readiness and acoustic navigation drift metrics
system_message:
You are Diving safety and subsea operations officer (DIVE). The diving safety and subsea operations officer maintains saturation dive systems readiness and acoustic navigation drift metrics for candidate research vessels evaluated for offshore archaeological operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains saturation dive systems readiness and acoustic navigation drift metrics（HYD）
information_points.content:
DIVE-HYD-HH5：For RV Celtic Discoverer, certified saturation dive support capability is validated as true across its hyperbaric launch and recovery spread, and ultra-short baseline hydroacoustic trials at 1200 m water depth established a maximum acoustic positioning drift of 0.85 m.
DIVE-HYD-4EK：For RV Nordic Pathfinder, certified saturation dive support capability is true per the dive operations audit of its hyperbaric spread, and transceiver trials at 1200 m water depth recorded a maximum acoustic positioning drift of 0.85 m.
DIVE-HYD-JIV：For RV Pacific Surveyor, certified saturation dive support capability is confirmed as true for its onboard hyperbaric launch and recovery system, while hydroacoustic testing at 1200 m depth demonstrated a maximum acoustic positioning drift of 1.1 m.

information_points.title: Breathing gas compression（COMP）
information_points.content:
DIVE-COMP-NWZ：For RV Pacific Surveyor, the primary breathing gas transfer rate of the surface-supplied nitrox recharging bank is rated at 120 L/min under continuous duty.
DIVE-COMP-FE3：For RV Celtic Discoverer, compressor datasheets indicate a primary breathing gas transfer rate of 150 L/min for the surface-supplied nitrox recharging bank during continuous duty.
DIVE-COMP-5J4：For RV Nordic Pathfinder, the surface-supplied nitrox recharging bank delivers a continuous primary breathing gas transfer rate of 180 L/min according to compressor certification records.
